| This scenario is available in the Defender portal only. | Partners can submit inquiries and respond to follow-up on behalf of customer in Defender portal through GDAP. | +| **Reporting** | Post monthly reports on managed threat hunting done by Defender Experts | Review the report. | This scenario is available in the Defender portal only. | Partners can review the Defender Experts report in the Defender portal through GDAP.   • Post automated notifications on incidents awaiting remediation action.
  • Reply to inquiries.
|

  • Review notifications.
  • Respond to Defender Experts questions, if any.
  • Post questions to Defender Experts, if any, on remediation actions.
